review:
A frozen lake and a taller 5x4 grid, with snowmobiles joining the usual rods and reels. The extra row gives more room for fish and fishermen to land together.

Three or more scatters unlock free spins, where the fisherman collects every fish's cash prize, and four fishermen move you up a level, retriggering spins and raising the multiplier. A good seasonal pick that plays a little differently from the 5x3 games. 96.08% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
